quark.jei.hint.dragon_scale: Drops from the Dragon from any kills beyond the first.
quark.jei.hint.music_disc_endermosh: Can be found in Void City chests.

quark.jei.hint.myalite_crystal_viaduct: When a Voidman or player using a Void Pearl teleports adjacent to multiple of these in a line, they'll end up at the other end of the line instead. Forks work, but loops will not.
advancements.quark.watcher_center.descri: Look at the center of a Void Watcher
advancements.quark.use_viaduct.descripti: Toss a Void Pearl to the tip of a line of Myalite Crystals to travel through them
